_comment: B1-047 D2.9: hand-authored FIX guidance for the most common authoring diagnostics. The generator fails if any code in requiredCoverage lacks an entry, if an entry names a code that is never raised, and prints how many extracted codes carry fixes. Write the fix as an imperative an AI can execute.

fixes.DDN001: Split the file (>2,000,000 chars): move data blocks into imported files, or replace verbose object lists with a records block.
fixes.DDN003: Remove the raw newline inside the string; use the JSON escape \n or split into two properties.
fixes.DDN005: Replace the non-finite number (NaN/Infinity) with a finite literal; use null or missing for unknown values.
fixes.DDN007: Reduce nesting below 80 levels; flatten deep records into x_record payloads or extra objects.
fixes.DDN008: Rename the record key: __proto__, prototype and constructor are reserved; quote is not enough, choose another key.
fixes.DDN011: Remove the duplicate key/property in the same body (e.g. kind: written twice, or kind: inside a typed declaration).
fixes.DDN012: Fix the version header: first tokens must be exactly ddn "0.5"; (accepted: "0.2".."0.5").
fixes.DDN013: Fix the module id: must match [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]* — no spaces; quote the id string.
fixes.DDN014: Rename the import alias; aliases must be unique across the whole merged file-level import list.
fixes.DDN015: Move the import: it is legal only before the FIRST module header, or immediately after it before that section's first declaration.
fixes.DDN020: Fix the import path: workspace-relative POSIX only — no scheme, no leading /, no backslashes, .. must stay inside the workspace.
fixes.DDN023: Rename one module: module ids must be unique workspace-wide, including sibling sections of one file.
fixes.DDN024: Rename one declaration: identities are unique across sections (symbol key module::path); also check for a compact-form duplicate.
fixes.DDN025: Only data, format and view declarations are legal at module top level; move the construct inside one of those.
fixes.DDN031: Fix the @reference: check spelling; use @alias.path for imports, @module.id.path for sibling sections (longest module prefix wins), or a local path.
fixes.DDN032: Use a length unit (px|pt|mm|cm|in) in this geometry context; temporal units (ms|s|min|h|d) are rejected here.
fixes.DDN033: Remove or rename the property: only keys in the PROPERTIES whitelist for this declaration type are allowed (x_* extensions always pass).
fixes.DDN040: Pass --view <name>, or declare a view: a bare check builds the first view of the entry file's FIRST module, which declares none.
fixes.DDN041: Add data: [@yourDataBlock]; to the view — an array of data-block references is required.
fixes.DDN042: Only object/domain/sample/flow/assertion/relation (or compact equivalents) are legal inside data; remove the offending child (fields group only holds fields).
fixes.DDN043: Point format: at a bundle declaration (format x { bundle b {…} }), not at a single concern declaration.
fixes.DDN044: Point the concern reference (layout:/display:/…) at a declaration of that same concern type.
fixes.DDN046: Use a value from the CHOICES enum table for this property; anything else is rejected.
fixes.DDN047: legend mode numbers requires a visible legend: do not set legend: off / placement: none with mode: numbers.
fixes.DDN051: Add both columns: [@field,…] and rows: [[…],…] to the sample block.
fixes.DDN052: Each sample column must resolve to a field — bind @object.field, not the object itself.
fixes.DDN053: Make every sample row exactly as wide as the columns array.
fixes.DDN055: Give the relation both endpoints: relation id @source -> @target {…}.
fixes.DDN056: Use a verb keyword from the relationship tables (or a registered alias); quote dotted profile verbs like "uml.message".
fixes.DDN057: select:/exclude: entries must resolve to elements in the view's data scope; fix the ref or its data: list.
fixes.DDN061: Number EVERY visible relation in legend.keys when mode: numbers — add the missing relation id or drop the relation.
fixes.DDN062: place targets must be selected elements: remove the place block or add the element to the selection.
fixes.DDN063: route targets must be visible relations (both endpoints selected); fix the ref or the selection.
fixes.DDN071: Text below the publication minimum: enlarge publication width/height, raise minimum_text, reduce content, or drop long labels. Rule of thumb: keep labels short and give dense graphs >=1200px width.
fixes.DDN073: route via points must be axis-aligned (orthogonal); fix the waypoints or set policy: repair to let the runtime recompute.
fixes.DDN102: Endpoint kinds violate the verb's contract — check the verb's source/target kind columns in the relationship table and change the kind or the verb.
fixes.DDN106: Unknown semantic property in strict mode: use a registered data property (section table) or run validation mode: logical.
fixes.DDN114: Use an endpoint mark from the endpoint-mark table; structural marks (one/many/…) are legal only on structural-family relations.
fixes.DDN-PF001: Unknown profile id: quote it exactly as listed in the profile table (e.g. "erd.crowfoot@1"), including the @version suffix.
fixes.DDN-PF002: projection.kind must equal the profile's registered projection column — check the profile table and fix kind or profile.
fixes.DDN-PJ004: Unsafe binding path: use dot-separated safe paths like x_record.value, or the special names name/id/kind.
fixes.DDN-PJ005: Remove projection keys that are not legal for this projection.kind — see the supported-keys table; nothing is silently ignored.
fixes.DDN-PJ007: Every bound element (records/rows/columns/…) must belong to the view's data: scope — add the data block or fix the ref.
fixes.DDN-PJ009: Reference arrays hold 1..500 unique refs; use records: [] only as the intentional chart/table empty state.
fixes.DDN-PJ012: The filter emptied the selection: loosen filter criteria or add records; filters may not reduce to zero rows.
fixes.DDN-PJ030: Pick a mark from the chart mark list; check mark-specific requirements (categorical vs numeric x, series rules) for the chosen mark.
fixes.DDN-PJ032: y must bind finite numbers: fix the x_record payloads (real JSON numbers, not strings) or bind another key.
fixes.DDN-PJ033: Date x values must be real ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings in x_record; fix the payloads or use x_type: category.
fixes.DDN-PJ087: Under erd.crowfoot@1 every ref/assoc relation needs BOTH source_mark and target_mark from one|zeroone|many|zeromany.
fixes.DDN-E010: Load the named optional bundle: ddn-geo.js for geo views, ddn-iso.js for iso/depth (the CLI pre-loads both).
fixes.DDN-E013: Flow steps must follow existing visible relations in declared direction: add the missing relation or reorder steps (@a -> @b -> @c).
fixes.DDN-E014: Fix the motion property: motion flow|pulse|none; marker circle|square|rect; marker_size <=128px; speed <=10000; rate positive integer.
fixes.DDN-E016: records row width must equal the columns count; the message names the row and expected/actual counts — fix the row's values.
fixes.DDN-PJ149: x_endlabels on uml.association/uml.commpath only; multiplicity must be a UML form (1, 0..1, 0..*, 1..*, *)
fixes.DDN-PJ150: x_association_class needs a reference to a declared uml.class that is not an endpoint of its own association
fixes.DDN-PJ151: x_nary needs at least three distinct classifier ends (uml.class/interface/enumeration) across anchors and x_nary.ends, each a UML multiplicity
fixes.DDN-PJ152: x_genset is legal on uml.generalization only; all relations of a set (same name) must share one target classifier
fixes.DDN-PJ153: x_template applies to uml.class/uml.interface only; move the parameter list to a classifier kind
fixes.DDN-PJ154: x_member kind literal belongs on uml.enumeration members only, and enumeration members must be literals (or plain fields)
fixes.DDN-PJ155: Fragment operands: contiguous, non-overlapping, one span, anchored on the first covered message; nest strictly
fixes.DDN-PJ156: x_message.sort rules: create = first message of target; delete ends the lifeline; lost/found self-anchored; reply = x_return:true; gates need a fragment
fixes.DDN-PJ157: State invariant after: must reference a visible message incident to that participant
fixes.DDN-PJ158: Activation from:/to: must reference visible messages incident to the participant, earlier to later row
fixes.DDN-PJ159: time/duration annotations use UML constraint form, wrapped in braces: "{t..t+5}"
fixes.DDN-PJ160: x_state applies to state kinds only; submachine must reference a distinct declared state.state
fixes.DDN-PJ161: Pseudostates: choice 2+ out, junction pass-through, terminate no outgoing, history/entry/exit points inside a composite frame
fixes.DDN-PJ162: Time/change triggers use after(…), at(…) or when(…) with parentheses — fix the event text or drop the time-trigger prefix
fixes.DDN-PJ164: Commpaths carry role/multiplicity only (no qualifiers); deployment nesting frames scope to node kinds
fixes.DDN-PJ165: uml.assembly endpoints are components or their ports (fields are not ports); uml.delegation starts at a port member
fixes.DDN-PJ166: x_part fields: uml.class/uml.component/uml.collaboration owners, UML multiplicity
fixes.DDN-PJ167: flow.merge needs ≥2 incoming uml.flow edges and exactly one outgoing
fixes.DDN-PJ168: x_interrupt edges start inside an x_interruptible frame; x_exception edges target a handler action (flow.process)
fixes.DDN-PJ169: x_pin (set/streaming) applies to ports on flow.process/subprocess/objectnode only
fixes.DDN-PJ170: Slot value must match the classifier field datatype (numeric/boolean scalar forms)
fixes.DDN-PJ171: x_pack.visibility is meaningful only inside a uml.package frame — add the frame or drop the property
fixes.DDN-PJ172: Communication fragments reference visible uml.message relations; time/duration use {…} form
fixes.DDN-PJ173: Timing annotations/constraints use {…} form; lifeline messages need x_message.at (finite) and participant endpoints
fixes.DDN-PJ174: Interaction-use gates must be uniquely named; inline expansion supports one level
fixes.DDN-PJ175: x_event: event kinds only; terminate on end events; cancel/compensation on boundary/end; boundary events need x_event.on → task/subprocess
fixes.DDN-PJ176: complex/event gateway types require a BPMN process/choreography/conversation profile; event-based gateways need ≥2 outgoing flows
fixes.DDN-PJ177: x_activity markers apply to task/subprocess kinds; call/transaction are not choreography bands
fixes.DDN-PJ178: x_bands is flow.choreotask-only; a choreography task needs at least two participant bands
fixes.DDN-PJ180: bpmn.association needs a data node (dataobject/datainput/dataoutput/datastore) on one side and an activity on the other
fixes.DDN-PJ181: x_cmmn decorators apply to plan items; non-blocking is human-task-only, collapsed is stage-only
fixes.DDN-PJ182: Sentry attach: must resolve to a plan item (not itself); on_part: references an event listener or case file; sentryref targets a sentry
fixes.DDN-PJ183: Planning tables (x_planning) attach to stages or tasks only
fixes.DDN-PJ184: A case view declares exactly one cmmn.caseplan container
fixes.DDN-PJ185: SysML requirement dependencies: derive/copy/master between requirements, verify from a test case, satisfy from a block
fixes.DDN-PJ186: x_block compartments apply to sysml.block/sysml.interfaceblock fields; compartment is values/parts/references/operations/constraints
fixes.DDN-PJ187: x_port types ports of block-family kinds; multiplicity is UML form; nested port names unique
fixes.DDN-PJ188: x_unit must name a symbol in standard/registry/units.json and match its quantity kind
fixes.DDN-PJ189: sysml.parametric@2: each constraint binds at least one endpoint (the exactly-two rule is sysml.parametric@1/DDN-PJ122)
fixes.DDN-PJ190: Under sysml.* profiles composition/generalization connect block-family kinds
fixes.DDN-PJ191: sysml.flow endpoints are blocks or their ports (ibd@2); x_flow rate/probability/continuous annotate uml.flow under sysml.activity@1
fixes.DDN-PJ192: x_subdiagram on a DMN node must name an existing decision-projection (decision table) view
fixes.DDN-PJ193: x_boxed is presentation-only text on dmn.decision/dmn.bkm/dmn.decisionservice
fixes.DDN-PJ194: DMN requirement connectors: information from input data/decision, knowledge from a BKM, authority from a knowledge source or decision
fixes.DDN-PJW06: Informational: sysml behavioral profile is a rebadge of the UML machinery
